cooperation.description: Agree to one finite practical activity. Each person chooses their own work and route. Acceptance starts no movement and grants no materials or control. Either may leave; completed effects remain.

labels.alliance: Mutual alliance, without an expiry. Each person keeps independent choices and permissions; either may leave.
labels.ceasefire: Ceasefire for {seconds} game seconds. Acceptance stops our unreleased attacks on each other. Either may leave; a new chosen attack ends assent. Released effects remain.
labels.releasedRisk: An earlier released attack may still arrive.
labels.accept: Accept these terms; keep choosing my own work
labels.conclude: Conclude this activity without claiming success
labels.carry: Ask to carry this offered object
labels.takeCarry: Accept the separate gift and take actual custody
labels.lastSeen: Walk to where I last saw the quarry
labels.huntTerms: Hunt {quarry} together, meeting at {place}. You may be injured or killed. We choose our own actions and may stop. Division is decided from actual yield afterward.
labels.carryTerms: Carry {item} to {place}. This is a separate custody transfer and voluntary transport, without a loan or retrieval right.
labels.placeCarry: Put the agreed object down here
labels.prepare: Make one batch for this activity
labels.acceptAmendment: Accept revised terms and end unfinished work for the old terms
labels.declineAmendment: Decline amendment; keep the accepted activity
